Despite the more favorable view on asset growth, the alterna-tive asset mangers continue to trade at a significant P/E discount to traditionals. The group currently trades at 10.8x MSe 2018 EPS, a 3.0x turn discount to traditionals peers. This however is on total earnings per share, and is inclusive of performance fees which inves-tors use a Lower multiple on given volatility. However, we believe a
re-rating of the management fee portion of earnings ina SOTP valua-

tion alone could help close the overall P/E gap vs. traditionals.
